sourceCorrections.historicalRecordedReason: First precaution literally recommends an unregistered-effect chemical, immediately followed by prohibition of unregistered pesticides. Treat the first wording as a source contradiction; never teach it as permission. Current legal and product-label specifics require authoritative checks.
